'''Protozoans''' were a group of single-celled life forms. The [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]] were an example of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of protozoan.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
